measurementNotes: Node baseline was recorded against baseCommit before production edits; this oldest receipt did not capture per-file hashes.
Runtime before-query-index measurements use the intermediate paged implementation before migration 11 and candidate SQL selection, not the original baseCommit application.

Electron matrix preceded only the final terminal-budget accounting and equal-timestamp ordering refinement; that refinement passed six focused tests and a final text-interaction diagnostic. The full matrix was not repeated.
The final projection-only measurement was repeated for the cache refinement. Unchanged storage benchmarks were not repeated.
Electron eventLoopUtilization returned all zeros in this host and is unavailable as a CPU measurement. Use recorded app.getAppMetrics CPU samples.
IPC counters count send attempts and JSON-estimated bytes; the blocked-ACK case deliberately dropped one test delivery.
Renderer long-task observation was short. Main event-loop maximum still reached about 114-124 ms. This does not prove zero stutter.

Electron matrix seeded TaskRuntime history only. Explicit Fake Model uses in-memory Conversations without equally sized Live/message metadata; file-storage performance was measured separately in Node.
No pre-change full Electron memory comparison; process RSS/working sets are sampled and shared pages must not be interpreted as unique total memory.
